mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, signaled by a positive YoY change in real GDP, predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as rising aggregate demand boosts corporate revenues and earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative > 40% of the time following positive YoY GDP growth, or GDP growth IC is insignificantly different from zero (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production, signaled by a negative MoM change in the industrial production index, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as supply constraints weigh on corporate profitability.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive > 60% of the time following negative MoM IP changes, or IP growth IC is insignificantly different from zero (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment, signaled by a 0.3pp increase in the unemployment rate over 3 months, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as labor market weakness undermines consumer demand.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 40% of the time following a 0.3pp 3-month rise in unemployment, or unemployment rate IC is insignificantly different from zero (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve, signaled by the 10-year Treasury yield falling below the federal funds rate, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the inverted curve signals impending recession.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive > 40% of the time when the yield curve is inverted, or yield curve inversion IC is insignificantly different from zero (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A hawkish surprise at an FOMC meeting, signaled by the federal funds rate rising more than expected, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as tighter monetary policy weighs on risk assets.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.25pp above consensus forecast at FOMC meeting
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive > 60% of the time following a hawkish FOMC surprise, or the IC of FOMC hawkish surprises is insignificantly different from zero (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment, signaled by a 200k MoM decline in nonfarm payrolls, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the labor market shock undermines economic growth prospects.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 40% of the time following a 200k+ MoM payroll decline, or the IC of sharp payroll declines is insignificantly different from zero (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Surging housing starts, signaled by a 20% YoY increase in housing starts, predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the housing boom boosts economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative > 30% of the time during periods of surging housing starts, or the IC of housing starts growth is insignificantly different from zero (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Soaring input costs, signaled by a 5% YoY increase in the PPI for finished goods, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as rising costs squeeze corporate profit margins.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 40% of the time during periods of surging input costs, or the IC of PPI growth is insignificantly different from zero (p > 0.1).
